decisions.rationale: The approved dependency set contains no test framework; assertion-based test mains exercise behavior without expanding the dependency surface.

decisions.decision: Keep compiler provenance outside business records
decisions.rationale: Source locations and Java owner/member hints are required for instrumentation, but business graphs retain only opaque IDs and business labels.
Candidate implementation entries emit the precomputed opaque edge ID while an active graph context verifies that the edge belongs to it.

decisions.decision: Use the fully source-visible journey-warning manager as the polymorphic Mega proof
decisions.rationale: It exercises three real brownfield strategies without pretending binary-only dependency logic is understood.

decisions.decision: Bind runtime predicate probes to developer-only source lines
decisions.rationale: Sequence-only bytecode matching could attribute unrelated conditional jumps as business reasons.

decisions.decision: Interleave baseline and enabled load windows
decisions.rationale: Adjacent windows preserve workload totals while controlling phase-order machine drift in p95 comparison.

decisions.decision: Share visited-edge resolution between PlantUML and Mermaid
decisions.rationale: Both persisted formats must highlight exactly the same observed execution path.

decisions.decision: Reuse one Stop node with multiple outcome probes
decisions.rationale: The static business topology stays simple while each compiled return site still records the typed result.

decisions.decision: Translate result-relevant null checks to absence semantics
decisions.rationale: Optionality can explain a decision, but Java null syntax and identifier suffixes are implementation details.

decisions.decision: Use Maven as the source and classpath adapter
decisions.rationale: The build already owns accurate module source roots and dependency resolution, eliminating manual launcher setup.

decisions.decision: Offer one-off and lifecycle Maven invocation modes
decisions.rationale: Full coordinates minimize first-use configuration while a plugin execution supports concise repeat builds.

decisions.decision: Verify every analysis fingerprint before export
decisions.rationale: A clean repository can move to another commit after analysis. The check proves that the exported commit still contains the analyzed source.

decisions.decision: Use the complete Maven parameter pair as the JSON enablement signal
decisions.rationale: Existing diagram builds stay Git-free, while configured builds cannot silently omit revision data.

decisions.decision: Verify each source blob at the captured commit
decisions.rationale: Clean Git status does not include ignored generated files, so blob verification is required for an exact source link.
